input.explanation: No. The fix works entirely inside this repository and needs nothing outside it to change. account_page falls back to render_spend_summary → average_spend_per_item whenever the cache misses or refuses a connection. With the patch, that fallback makes one pass over the purchase history instead of re-summing it once per purchase. So while the cache is unreachable, every request pays a linear cost instead of a quadratic one, and that applies whether or not anyone corrects the port. Setting the port back to the one the cache actually listens on would bring the cache back, which helps further. But that is a config change in this same repo, and the code fix doesn't depend on it.
